children: Constellation Brands says its Hispanic consumers are bifurcated. Some shoppers in New York and California are buying beer more regularly again, while those in Florida and Texas have continued to cut back on drinking and going out, executives say during the Barclays Consumer Staples Conference. Overall, consumers are continuing to feel pressured, though shoppers on the highest end of the income spectrum are doing very well, the executives say.(katherine.hamilton@wsj.com)
